answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making every identity carry a public, append-only work ledger carved like marble: weight is earned only from jobs that unrelated peers verified as actually done. A fresh identity starts weightless, and climbing the mesa of trust takes weeks of real, checked work per account, so spinning up a thousand sock-puppets means paying that cost a thousand times. Old verified history becomes a relic no newcomer can fake overnight, and any identity caught copying another ledger is slashed to zero.
